units.source_text: 我们三个人去日本桥，买了要买的东西。

en.t: The three of us went to Nihonbashi and bought the things we needed to buy.

units.source_text: 买东西的时候，她们还老是改主意，挑来拣去的，比我预想的多花了时间。

en.t: While shopping, they kept changing their minds and picking things over, so it took longer than I had expected.

units.source_text: 夫人特意叫着我的名字，问我觉得怎么样。

en.t: The lady deliberately called me by name and asked what I thought.

units.source_text: 她总是把衣料搭在小姐的肩头，叫我后退几步瞧瞧好看不好看。

en.t: She would always drape the cloth over the young lady's shoulders and ask me to step back a few paces to see whether it looked good.

units.source_text: 每次我都煞有介事地说，这件不好看啦，那件很适合小姐等等。

en.t: Each time I would speak as if I knew what I was talking about, saying that this one did not look good or that one suited the young lady very well.

units.source_text: 就这样耽误了不少时间，回来时，已经到该吃晚饭的时候了。

en.t: In this way we lost quite a bit of time, and by the time we returned it was already time for dinner.

units.source_text: 夫人说要对我表示谢意，请我在外面吃饭，领着我去了一家名叫木原店的饭馆。

en.t: The lady said she wanted to thank me by treating me to dinner outside, and she took me to a restaurant called Kiharadana.

units.source_text: 饭馆位于一条有寄席的小巷里，不但巷子狭窄，饭馆的房间也很窄。

en.t: The restaurant was in a narrow lane with a vaudeville theater, and not only was the lane narrow, the room in the restaurant was narrow too.

units.source_text: 我对这一带一向不熟，见夫人如此熟悉，很是惊奇。

en.t: I had never been familiar with that area, so I was very surprised to see how well the lady knew it.
We did not get home until quite late.

units.source_text: 第二天是星期日，我一天没出门。

en.t: The next day was Sunday, and I did not go out all day.

units.source_text: 星期一去上学时，有个同学一大早就跟我开起了玩笑。

en.t: When I went to school on Monday, one of my classmates began teasing me first thing in the morning.

units.source_text: 他一本正经地问我什么时候结的婚，然后又夸赞我的妻子是个大美人。

en.t: With a perfectly serious face, he asked when I had got married, and then praised my wife as a great beauty.

units.source_text: 看来我们三个人去日本桥时，不知在哪里被他看见了。

en.t: It seemed that he had seen the three of us somewhere when we went to Nihonbashi.

units.source_text: 1.寄席：表演相声、曲艺、杂耍等民俗节目的剧场，盛行于江户时代。

en.t: 1. Yose: a theater for popular entertainments such as rakugo, storytelling, and acrobatics, which flourished in the Edo period.
